messages:
Asha (oncall): Evening handoff — quick summary before I sign off. Noticed a latency/5xx blip on /v2/generate starting ~18:05 PT, paging fired (multiple customers, us-west region). I'm primary until 01:00 PT, Samir is secondary for escalation. Current status: mitigation applied, errors down but still watching. Details below.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT at 2026-03-14T18:05:15Z — 502 spikes detected on /v2/generate (us-west), error rate 8% over 5m, p95 latency 420ms. Pager routed to eng-oncall.
Samir: Thanks — any customer-facing impact yet?
Asha (oncall): Intermittent 502/504 for a small subset of hosted accounts hitting long-context prompts. Not service-wide, but high-volume customers saw retries. No major SLA breach yet but could escalate.
Tom: I pulled logs, looks like batcher queue latencies spiked and a few backends hit OOM-kill on model-worker-3 in pool gpu-pool-2. Traces show KV cache miss storms on some path prefixes.
Asha (oncall): Steps we took: 1) temporarily disabled batching threshold bump (reverted previous change at 18:10), 2) scaled gpu-pool-2 +2 nodes, 3) purged prefix cache for affected keys (kv-cache/prefixes/large-context/*).
Riley: Good call. After scale + cache purge, error rate dropped to ~0.6% over 10m. p95 down to ~160ms.
Samir: Can you paste the runbook snippet you followed? I want to capture for handoff notes.
Asha (oncall): From runbook: "If generate 5xx > 5% and batcher queue growth > 3min: revert recent batching/threshold changes, increase pool by 1-3 nodes, trigger KV cache invalidation for affected prefixes, watch for OOM events." Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-batcher (internal).
Tom: Reproduction note: workload that caused it used unusually long context + streaming enabled; that combination pushes KV memory up because of many open KV slots while batching waits. Suggest we add a guard in runtime to cap concurrent KV reservations per-request. Filing follow-up.
eng-sre-bot: New ticket created: INF-4521 "batcher KV reservation guard + guardrails" assigned to Tom.
Asha (oncall): Coverage notes: overnight gap 03:00-07:00 PT currently has no dedicated infra responder on the rotation. We should decide coverage — for tonight, Tom agreed to cover 03:00-05:00, Samir will cover 05:00-07:00 if anything recurs.
Tom: Confirmed. I'll be reachable via phone for pager escalation 03:00-05:00.
Samir: I'll set a short escalation policy for the window — if errors > 3% for 5m escalate to infra-sig.
Asha (oncall): Customer comms: no need for broad notice yet; for impacted customers we sent targeted DM via account team. If errors reappear >2% for 10m, we'll push a status update. Owner: Riley for comms.
Riley: Noted. I'll prep a short status blurb and stand by.
Asha (oncall): Next steps (action items):
- Tom: implement INF-4521 guard (owner, in progress)
- Samir: add temporary alert adjustment to avoid noisy paging on small spikes (owner)
- Riley: draft customer status template if needed (owner)
- Asha: update runbook with the exact revert checklist + add the cache purge script snippet used (owner)
Asha (oncall): Current system state: errors down to baseline but monitoring on 1h auto-escalation. Please watch dashboards: /dashboards/latency/generate-us-west and /alerts/502-spike. If you see error compaction or new OOMs, escalate immediately.
Samir: Any idea root cause yet besides long-context + batching? Could be changed batching heuristics from yesterday's deploy.
Tom: Correlating with yesterday's runtime tweak (batching threshold). I think combination of tweak + workload spike was the trigger. We'll keep it as contributing factor.
Asha (oncall): I'll hand off now. Primary tonight: Samir (01:00 PT->04:00 PT?), wait — correction: I'm primary until 01:00 PT, Samir is secondary; Tom covers 03:00-05:00 for the overnight infrastructure gap; Samir will cover 05:00-07:00. Please refer to the incident timeline and INF-4521 for follow-up.
Samir: Got it — I'm primary after 01:00 PT, will monitor dashboards and follow the playbook.
eng-sre-bot: Handoff noted: oncall_primary=Asha until 01:00 PT, oncall_secondary=Samir, overnight_infra_coverage=Tom 03:00-05:00, Samir 05:00-07:00.
Asha (oncall): Thanks all. If nothing else, I'll check back at 23:00 PT for a quick checkpoint, otherwise see you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
